title: Bridged Self-Distillation for On-Policy Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.26397v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: On-policy distillation can transfer the reasoning capabilities of a strong teacher to a smaller student. However, distillation from a stronger teacher model faces two mismatches: its solutions may be difficult for a smaller student to imitate, and its token-level probabilities may be incompatible with, or even unavailable to, the student. Existing methods handle these settings through different forms of supervision. To this end, we propose Bridged Self-Distillation (BSD), a unified framework for distilling from any teacher that provides reasoning traces. The model to be distilled from, termed the external teacher, first provides a reasoning trace as privileged context, which can be generated in an offline fashion. The student generates rollouts without this context, while a copy of the student conditioned on it, serving as the self-teacher, scores the same rollouts in the student's own token space. translated_title: 面向在线策略学习的桥接自蒸馏
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏可以将强大教师模型的推理能力迁移到更小的学生模型中。然而，从更强的教师模型进行蒸馏面临两个不匹配问题：其解答可能难以被较小的学生模型模仿，且其词元级概率可能与学生模型不兼容，甚至无法获取。现有方法通过不同形式的监督来处理这些情况。为此，我们提出了桥接自蒸馏，这是一个能够从任何提供推理轨迹的教师模型进行蒸馏的统一框架。被蒸馏的模型被称为外部教师，它首先提供一个推理轨迹作为特权上下文，该上下文可以以离线方式生成。学生模型在无此上下文的情况下生成采样序列，而一个以该上下文为条件的学生模型副本作为自教师，在学生自身的词元空间中对相同的采样序列进行评分。BSD利用由此产生的词元级（概率信号进行训练……摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出桥接自蒸馏框架，通过让学生模型以教师推理轨迹为条件的副本充当自教师、在学生自身的词元空间中对学生的采样序列进行评分，从而统一解决了在线策略蒸馏中教师解答难以模仿与词元级概率不兼容或不可获取的两大难题。
en_tdlr: Proposes Bridged Self-Distillation (BSD), a unified framework in which a copy of the student conditioned on the teacher's reasoning trace serves as a self-teacher to score the student's own rollouts in the student's token space, resolving the two mismatches when distilling from stronger teachers—difficult-to-imitate solutions and incompatible or unavailable token-level probabilities.
